email.body1:
Marye, saw Nowsta is pushing AI-powered scheduling that cuts scheduling time by 80 percent across flex-workforce teams.

Leaning into an AI story usually surfaces more operators and staffing firms in play than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nowsta off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Marye, quick follow-up for Nowsta.

As the AI scheduling story expands, the pipeline target tends to grow faster than the team can. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nowsta needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Marye, last bit of proof for Nowsta.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nowsta's reply rate likely compares to peer workforce-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
